submitted.rationale: Out of 3 measurements, index 3 (Co0.84Sb0.16) gave the highest EQE (0.0118%). EQE rose as the film became more Co-rich (Sb 0.67 → -0.009, Sb 0.28 → 0.005, Sb 0.16 → 0.012). All values are very small, so the whole library responds weakly at 2.7 eV.

rejected.reason: At the CoSb2O6 trirutile stoichiometry, measured EQE was about zero (-0.009%)
